name: [RIKA] Sorcerer Ascent
desc:
Escaping from your destroyed village you decide to become a sorcerer helping people around the world and fighting evil sorcerers. Complete lots of unique quests, fight strong opponents, complete Dungeons to obtain rarest equipment, complete College Missions to increase your sorcerer grade and become the strongest sorcerer of today!

Each Innate Technique has a Domain Expansion!

Domain Expansion applies a sure hit effect to Technique Abilities!

HEAVENLY RESTRICTION + BOSS RUSH GAME MODE
- NEW Power System Heavenly Restriction
- New Special Clan Zenin 
- New Game Mode Boss Rush
- New HR Weapon Playful Cloud
- And more!



PC, Mobile and Console Support

Current Max Level is 150!

⭐ Remember to join the group and like the game!
